essence: Self-willed vibration of the Highest is the first Śiva-tattva.
Transparent ever-present will-power seeds the self-hidden world.
Self-covering abiding in all-grace is Sadāśiva.
All-become Lordship yields pure knowledge of this-I non-difference.
Māyā differentiates own-portion beings while unbridled power shore-blocks.
